card.name: The word one before day
card.fires_on: The word "one" right after a modal like may, could or will, where "day" is expected next to form "one day". It also fires weakly on numbers or "twice" just before "day" or "daily".

modes.label: One day (someday)
modes.description: The word "one" after may, could, will or hope that, predicting "day" in a future-possibility sense.

modes.label: Number or twice before day
modes.description: A number or "twice" in a dosing or duration phrase where "day" or "days" comes next.
